description: Requirement-to-evidence matrix for the expanded v0.3 contract. Rows are statements; evidence items are executable tests, scripts, native commands or documents. The planned field is descriptive text naming outstanding work and its owner; planned items are visible but never count as covered.

rows.statement: Both profiles meet p99 frame_wall of at most 16.67 ms on every workload.

evidence.planned: render qualification gate (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: The Python budget evaluator reports the 8.33 ms target (p50 for Quality, p50 and p99 for Performance); its pass/fail decision uses only the floor verdict.

Client reports must record GL vendor, renderer and version from glGetString. RenderContractPython accepts synthetic qualified-adapter strings and rejects a renderer mismatch against the qualified RTX 5070 Ti; it does not exercise glGetString or the client report assignments. GL identity recording remains outstanding native qualification.

evidence.planned: render qualification runner (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: The client must record frame wall, CPU submit, present and GPU timings with frame attribution and explicit unavailability. Software ring and query tests exercise attribution with fake queries; client timing assignments and real GL timestamp capture remain outstanding native/GPU qualification.

evidence.planned: render qualification runner (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: The software sample ring preserves frame identity when results resolve out of order. GpuQueryRing with fake queries attributes delayed results to their originating frames and leaves unsupported GPU timings and incomplete pass timings unavailable.

Client reports must emit p50, p95, p99, maximum and median absolute deviation through Measurement::add_distributions. RenderMeasurementStatistics exercises summarize and RenderContractPython constructs synthetic distributions; neither calls Measurement::add_distributions or generates a client report. Distribution emission remains outstanding native qualification.

evidence.planned: render qualification runner (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: C++ summarize and tools/perf/perf.py compute p50, p95, p99, maximum and median absolute deviation against the shared fixture. The render capture validator checks synthetic distributions against frame samples and rejects a forged p95 or mean.
Fixed views run 400 warm-up and 240 measured frames at pinned seed, preset, time of day and field of view.

evidence.planned: render qualification workload manifest (v0.3.1); owner: ac
render qualification runner (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: Scripted 60 s traversals with pinned seeds, camera paths and cold-cache state meet the floor; streaming transients are included.

evidence.planned: render qualification runner (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: The cave-walk and edited-world-tour traversals exist, include an identified edit, a snapshot commit and the all-tier bake inside the measured window, and meet the floor.

evidence.planned: traversal v2 and cave poses; ac AC8 spec; owner: fw; issue #132

rows.statement: A capture is invalid, independent of thresholds, on incomplete timers, an undeclared calendar or render debug override, a workload manifest mismatch, or an unsettled far ladder.

evidence.planned: far ladder settle evidence (90 s limit) is not yet in the artifact or validator; owner: fw

rows.statement: The far horizon gate requires complete per-tier coverage against an independently computed wanted set, below-horizon sky at most 2 percent, no seam band and no edge at the outer radius.

evidence.planned: Ladder qualification refuses until immutable fixture authority is supported; owner: fw

rows.statement: The matrix checker requires a row for every ID in the contract requirement list, resolves non-planned test and file references, and checks that native evidence names a command and receipt schema. Its tests reject missing required mappings and invalid references; this is static inventory validation.
A world saved at tick N, loaded and advanced K ticks equals an uninterrupted N+K run over every persisted subsystem, with negative controls per subsystem.

evidence.planned: save/load versus uninterrupted simulation oracle; owner: ds

rows.statement: The far ladder, caves and seams are covered on default, mountains, archipelago and cave-dense fixtures.

evidence.planned: Ladder qualification refuses until immutable fixture authority is supported; owner: fw

rows.statement: Edits bake to all tiers and far authority is preserved across save and load.

evidence.planned: all-tier edit bake regression; owner: fw; issue #132

rows.statement: Snapshot commit survives interruption after every rename and during the bake, and the catalog inspects read-only.

evidence.planned: snapshot commit interruption regression; owner: fw

rows.statement: Clock, ledger, pages, creatures and water persist and round-trip with negative controls.

evidence.planned: save/load versus uninterrupted simulation oracle; owner: ds

rows.statement: Hash pins and additivity guards hold; replay and lockstep require native qualification with checkpoint exchange enabled. ReplayRoundtrip verifies checkpoints at ticks 30/60/90, ReplayDivergence rejects the corrupted tick-30 checkpoint, and LockstepLoopback runs two peers for 90 ticks with cadence hash exchange. Qualification receipts remain outstanding.
Benchmark schema v3 artifacts exist for six fixed views and three traversals per profile per display, checked by the render contract tools.

evidence.planned: render qualification runner (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: The client hang watchdog fires once per stall, never fires while the heartbeat advances, and re-arms after the heartbeat resumes (report archival is campaign evidence, not covered here).

Per-system simulation tick work counts must be captured deterministically on representative worlds. SimBudgetCaptureContract validates synthetic artifacts and command construction; representative-world capture receipts remain required.

Synthetic caps are enforced in SimBudgetProfileTest and SimBudgetTelemetry: stage work above the cap is a violation, equality passes, missing residency samples remain unevaluated, and synthetic smoke artifacts fail on a stage violation. Production enforcement remains deferred: all committed baseline limits are null and CI runs check_sim_budgets.py without --require-complete. Measured limits must be pinned and --require-complete enabled in CI before production coverage can be claimed.

evidence.planned: pin measured limits and workload identity, then enable --require-complete in CI; owner: ac

rows.statement: AsyncSavedWorldCatalog coalesces refreshes and discards stale results. With the saved-world fixture, owning-thread Request and Poll calls each return within 1000 ms and the scan finishes within 120 s; corrupt region files are refused. These tests exercise the catalog API, not the client UI event loop.
A packaged build completes create, edit, save, restart, select, load and world switching with byte-identical authority replacement.

Saved terrain edits must render identically across hierarchical culling boundaries and world switches. TerrainCulling tests the visibility oracle; the lifecycle driver records switch captures but visual comparison of saved edits remains native evidence outstanding.
A no-UI saved-world load exits cleanly and produces a nonblack capture whose context agrees with the artifact.
Serial loading, the networking soak and the performance gates are qualified together in one v0.3 acceptance receipt.

Every ID in the distant-world contract requirement list has a matrix row with named evidence. AcceptanceMatrixContract rejects deletion of each required production mapping; evidence execution and completeness of the requirement list are separate obligations.

Client reports must record GL vendor and renderer strings and emit per-frame render timing distributions through Measurement::add_distributions, alongside profiles, displays and traversal workloads. Cited software tests exercise statistics and synthetic artifact validation, not GL identity recording, distribution emission or client report generation; those runtime paths remain outstanding native qualification.

evidence.planned: render qualification runner (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: Per-system simulation tick budgets must be measured on representative worlds and proposed from observed work. Capture and proposal tooling is available and tested with synthetic inputs; representative-world capture and proposal receipts remain required.
Reversed-Z float depth is adopted with no GL error-severity output on a fixed view.

evidence.planned: GL debug output qualification checker (v0.3.1); owner: ac

rows.statement: Server autosave records absolute tick 45, full snapshot reload preserves the tick and default world-clock bytes, and wind, weather, aether and world-clock state match after five further ticks. Negative simulationTick metadata refuses load and save without changing disk bytes. These tests do not establish client rendering or custom-calendar unification.

The expanded v0.3 contract requires native qualification and production simulation and residency budget enforcement. Measured simulation limits and --require-complete in CI remain outstanding; residency classes are unevaluated until the engine emits samples. The aggregate v0.3 driver does not evaluate simulation or residency budgets.

evidence.planned: pin measured limits and require complete CI checks; production residency samples and separate budget qualification are outstanding; owner: ac

rows.statement: Host-independent ambient field hashes require matching constructor and evolved receipts from at least two different hosts with different active ISA dispatch levels (SSE2 and AVX2 under the same dispatch ceiling). Current single-host receipts and the ASan-only comparison do not cover this requirement; cross-host qualification remains planned.

evidence.planned: collect JUnit receipts on separate SSE2 and AVX2 hosts, verify their host identities and active_simd values 4 and 256, then compare; the comparator alone does not attest host identity; owner: ac

rows.statement: Wind's short position-array call sites must provide whole-vector padded storage so SIMD tail loads stay within the allocation. AmbientInputBounds demonstrates that an unpadded two-element input faults and sixteen-element padding succeeds; a bounds regression tied to the production wind call sites remains planned.

evidence.planned: exercise production wind call sites with guard-page bounds evidence; existing probes call the noise library directly; owner: ac
